review: The optional typed beforeAction callback is awaited only when supplied. Existing default callers keep the same sequence and no extra await, operation, evidence or authority renewal.

The five hook sites precede the initial real case read, each of the three existing HTTP commands and the final real case read. Payloads, expected case version, criteria/result source refs, comparisons and choice assertions remain unchanged.

Only purchase supplies the hook. selectWp12ProcurementPeriod performs genuine public selection creation in both installed services and the separate companion business instance; it does not cache or extend an admission, retry a denied action, or renew during an action.
The public selection operation sf_work_list and the sf_request_read/sf_context_get diagnostic operations already exist in the purchase grant. No grant expansion or private period-map access is added.

The diagnostic direct readers correctly use the existing context.ui wrapper, because they consume the admission before invoking domain ports; these are not services.dispatch calls and do not incur the separately found duplicate-validation issue.

The failure probe uses two independent admissions, does not renew selection, records concrete statuses/reasons and rethrows the original error. It labels the observations companion-business and does not infer installed-host private lease state from them.

The known 300-second period registry supplies a source-consistent expiry hypothesis, but case-evidence-unavailable alone did not prove that cause. Instrumentation preserves this distinction; no repaired hosted result is claimed.
No existing deadline, real raw source, financial discriminator, derivedMissing assertion, request authority or model behavior changes.
limits: Static source/diff review only; no product test, typecheck, CI or edits to the reviewed source files.
The pending derivedMissingCategoryIds failure is separate and remains strict.
Selection age is measured around the public call; it is not asserted to be an internal issuedAt/expiresAt value.
A new hosted run is required to observe whether a lease still expires within any individual expensive action.
